name: __TILDAZ_EXT_NAME__
description: Places TildaZ terminals (Wayland app_id=__TILDAZ_APP__.instanceN) as drop-down windows. Cinnamon on Wayland only — muffin has no wlr-layer-shell, so placement must be done from the shell process (this extension), mirroring the GNOME Shell extension. See https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz issue #229.
